description: The Ancient Carrier trail route from Noonla to Stuart River and then on to Stuart Lake. This trail was the main pack trail to the Omineca Gold Fields in the 1870's. Length:15km from the trailhead on Striegler Pit Road to the old ferry crossing on Stuart River. Side trails to McLeod Meadow and Wonder and Expected Lakes.
directions: From Vanderhoof head North from HWY 16 on Burrard avenue, cross the Bridge and turn East on Loop Road, continue past the golf course and once just past the Airport turn Right on Striegler Pit road travel roughly 4 km to the trailhead on your left.
title: Omineca
